summary: Iteration 127 - P1 Operations Features (Shift Scheduler, Reception Report, Pass Over Duties) fully tested. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all components loading correctly, data displaying properly, and full CRUD flows working.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement recommended

endpoints: GET /api/operations/shifts/all?week_start=YYYY-MM-DD - returns {week_start, week_end, days[7], staff[], total_staff}
POST /api/operations/shifts/all/assign - creates/upserts shift with preset (morning=07:00-15:00, afternoon=12:00-20:00)
features: Morning preset correctly produces 07:00-15:00 with color #22c55e
Afternoon preset correctly produces 12:00-20:00 with color #06b6d4
Clear week deletes all shifts for specified week
Endpoints require admin/manager role (401 without auth)
Returns KPIs: bookings_created, check_ins, check_outs, cancellations, routine_runs
Returns detail arrays for each KPI category

endpoints: POST /api/operations/pass-over/all/{id}/acknowledge - sets status='acknowledged', pushes to acknowledgements[]
features: Create pass-over with title, message, priority, category, shift, mentions
Acknowledge adds user info to acknowledgements array

features_verified: Weekly Gantt grid with 7 days
Staff member rows with role badges and daily rates
Role filtering (All, Receptionist, Housekeeper, Maintenance)
Week navigation arrows
Publish All, Approve All, Clear Week bulk action buttons
Shift cells show time range and color-coded by preset
Status legend (planned, published, approved, completed)
5 KPI cards: Bookings Created (75), Check-ins (3), Check-outs (0), Cancellations (4), Routine Runs (0)
Date range inputs for filtering
4 detail tables with guest names and dates
Color-coded KPI cards (blue, green, violet, red, amber)
Status filter tabs (Open, Acknowledged, Archived, All) with counts
Priority filter buttons (All, Critical, High, Normal, Low)
New Pass Over button opens dialog
Create Shift Handover dialog with Title, Message, Priority, Category, Shift, Mention Staff
Pass-over cards show title, priority badge, category badge, shift badge, message, mentions, from_user, timestamp
Ack button acknowledges pass-over
Archive and Delete buttons visible for admin/manager
Toast notifications for create/acknowledge/archive/delete actions
Sidebar nav items present: shift-scheduler-btn, reception-report-btn, pass-over-btn
All nav items clickable and navigate to correct views

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
All endpoints properly protected with role-based authentication
Shift presets correctly map to time ranges (morning=07:00-15:00, afternoon=12:00-20:00, evening=15:00-23:00, night=23:00-07:00, full=09:00-17:00)
Pass-over acknowledgements correctly track user, role, and timestamp
Reception report KPIs correctly aggregate booking data
Minor: DialogContent missing aria-describedby for accessibility
